notes: The waw of וְעָשִׂיתִי is unrepresented: the ASV writes no connective before *I will do*, and rule 14 requires a word actually written for it.
כַּאֲשֶׁר fuses into the single *when* (rule 30); the margin's *according as* occupies the same one-word slot and does not change the unit.
*myself* renders the Niphal's own voice and stays in the verb's unit under rule 44; the unit heads on the lexical *known*.
